$comment: Community notices. Each notice needs a unique id (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens), a published date (YYYY-MM-DD) and a title. 'expires' is the last day the notice is shown (YYYY-MM-DD); leave it out to show the notice for 30 days. 'body' is a list of plain-text paragraphs. The build fails, and the live site stays unchanged, if this file is invalid.

notices.title: Gravel-road works are in progress.
body: Construction and renewal of gravel roads are ongoing in the area. Community members, residents and visitors are asked to take care around heavy vehicles.
